annotations.title: US airport delays, ground stops and closures

description: Live FAA National Airspace System status for US airports: ground stops, ground delay programs, arrival and departure delays (with minimum, maximum and trend) and closures, each with its reason. Give an IATA code such as LGA for one airport (normal when nothing is reported), or nothing for the whole country. Public FAA data, refreshed about every minute. Use before travel planning, logistics or customer notices. Example: airport=LGA. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

airport.description: IATA airport code such as LGA, SFO or ORD (default: all US airports with events)
